name: Ossuar the Bone Sun

abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
abilities.description: If Ossuar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

abilities.name: Spirit Jar
abilities.description: If destroyed, Ossuar reforms in 1d10 days if it has a spirit jar, reviving with all its hit points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within Ossuar's lair.

abilities.name: Protective Magic (3/Day) (Reaction)
abilities.description: When Ossuar is hit by an attack, it casts *shield* in response, gaining a +5 bonus to AC until the start of its next turn, including against the triggering attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ossuar makes three attacks, using Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) or (B) Spellcasting to cast *Ray of Sickness*.

actions.name: Eldritch Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) force damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the start of Ossuar's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
Ossuar casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19): -

At will: *detect magic*, *detect thoughts*, *dispel magic*, *fireball*, *invisibility*, *lightning bolt*, *mage hand*, *prestidigitation*

2/day each: *animate dead*, *dimension door*, *plane shift*

1/day each: *chain lightning*, *finger of death*, *power word kill*, *scrying*

legendary_actions.name: Deathly Teleport
legendary_actions.description: Ossuar teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and each creature within 10 feet of the space it left takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

legendary_actions.name: Disrupt Life
legendary_actions.description: Each creature that isn't an undead within 20 feet of Ossuar must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 31 (9d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Ossuar can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Frightening Gaze
legendary_actions.description: Ossuar casts *fear*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Ossuar can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

other_edition.lore: Once a king who bound his soul to a dead sun of carved bone, Ossuar now drifts around the corpse-world he ruled, gathering the dying into his court of husks so that nothing ever truly ends.
